text:
Rae (People Ops): Aurelio's start Tue but flagged a couple things: he's in COVID isolation until Mon evening, has an H-1B receipt notice (I-797 receipt) not the final visa yet, and needs Tagalog interpreter for Day 1. He asked if we can do curbside laptop pick-up and a short curbside I-9 check to avoid entering the building.

Nico (Recruiter): Candidate prefers curbside or hotel hold-for pickup. He says I-797 is current proof of work authorization for I-9 (List A) along with his passport. Is that ok?

Lina (Onboarding): Short answer: I-797 receipt notice plus unexpired foreign passport showing admission stamp works for List A if it's accompanied by the approval notice or I-94 depending on status. We can do an in-person I-9 curbside if a People Ops rep or notary meets him outside and sights originals. Remote notary won't work for initial I-9 if candidate isn't showing USCIS documents in person. Need original docs at verification.

Accessibility-bot: Note from accessibility: Aurelio requested a quiet room for orientation and live-captioned materials; Tagalog interpreter booked for first hour. We can arrange a single-person conference room and remote captioning for videos.

IT-bot: Curbside pickup allowed. Use exact label for FedEx/hand-off: 
"Hold for: Aurelio Santos / Redwood Inference - Curbside Pickup" + mobile. Asset held until AUP signed. If curbside handoff, People Ops rep must confirm ID and get AUP ack before unlocking device. VPN/profile staged after AUP.

BGCheck Vendor: Vendor note: I-797 + passport okay to verify identity/work auth for onboarding tasks; background checks may still request SSN later. Please get signed consent now to start ID-only checks. International addresses may extend some county-level searches.

Rae (People Ops): Plan: 1) Book curbside slot Mon 7pm outside HQ (Aurelio arrives directly from isolation), 2) Tagalog interpreter & quiet room reserved for Day 1, 3) Ask Aurelio to upload photos of I-797 + passport to secure portal by EOD Sun as backup, 4) FedEx-bot/IT to label package for curbside hold and AUP link to be emailed now.

Aurelio (candidate): I can do Mon 7pm curbside. Uploading photos now and signed BG consent. Thanks for the Tagalog interpreter and quiet room ":thumbsup:"

FedEx-bot: Confirmed: curbside hold label format accepted. Tracking will include "Curbside Pickup" note. Use mobile verification at handoff.

Lina (Onboarding): Calendar invite sent with curbside instructions and fallback NotaryNow info if anything changes. Closing once AUP signed and docs uploaded.

Rae (People Ops): Thanks team ":pray:"
